_comment: A broken cavalry block whose flight bends onto a detour round a long wall keeps its leading riders with their places. Team 0's 64 horses (default Cavalry geometry for 64: 8 files by 8 ranks, about 280 wu wide and 840 wu deep, file pitch 40 wu, rank pitch 120 wu) spawn ALREADY routing (starting_state 3, morale 1.0) facing north, their own back edge, centred on x 1000 with their front rank at y 1980. A wall of block terrain (x 700-1300, y 1650-1770) stands 210 wu ahead across the whole line of flight, reaching 160 wu past the block's flank files on either side, so the flight cannot run straight on: its step heads for the wall's west end, and the block's heading turns north-west onto that detour while the flight gathers pace (the anchor runs from (999.8, 2399.7) at tick 8 to about (651, 2028) at tick 350, still south of the wall: the clip ends before the block reaches the wall's end). No rider reaches the wall: soldiers_at_block_terrain_edge reads 0 at every declared tick, so nothing here is a side-step along a face. As the flight turns and speeds up, a slot's own velocity can change faster than the rider on it can follow at his acceleration, and riders fall behind their places. A rider now takes, on top of his acceleration, part of the change in his own feed-forward (the flight velocity, his place's turning velocity and any friendly-contact steering) while it is not slowing: none within 60 wu (3 m) of his place, rising to all of it from 120 wu (6 m) off, capped at twice his acceleration (SoldierBodies.flight_accel_share). Measured 2026-11-06 on Windows on d2b7e7b4 against main 806be006, full state dumps at the declared ticks and dense 2-tick FULL dumps, seeds 0 to 4 and the clip's own seed (all identical: nothing here draws on the seed): slot_distance_max (the farthest any rider stands from his place) is 96.9, 94.3 and 72.8 wu at ticks 240, 300 and 350, with no rider more than one rank pitch (120 wu) off; on 806be006 109.1, 130.1 and 166.2 wu, with 0, 1 and 2 riders more than a rank pitch off. The slot_distance_max pins at ticks 300 and 350 allow one rank pitch, which 806be006 exceeds at both and d2b7e7b4 does not. The defect scan finds nothing on d2b7e7b4 at either sampling. Its closest call is uid 0 superphysical_speed: the fastest rider reads 246.1 wu/s against the 254.6 wu/s ceiling (96.7 percent), against 217.9 on 806be006, the same on every one of those seeds and samplings. The tick-8 position pins are setup pins (the spawn), not claims about the fix; the soldiers_at_block_terrain_edge pins hold on both trees and pin the staging (a bend with no rider at the wall). A routing unit's rout timer (6 s) runs out at tick 360 and it rallies; the clip ends at tick 352, just before that. A small idle team-1 Infantry block 700 wu east keeps the router in the close sim tier; all_teams_control leaves both sides without AI. No scripted inputs: the flight runs on its own. Flat declared map apart from the wall; drill mode. Run by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd; world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
